objective: Add a user-selectable dark theme to the Leave Request form without changing behaviour or layout.

cards.title: Define light and dark colour tokens as CSS variables
acceptanceChecks: Every colour used by the form has a --token with a light value
A [data-theme="dark"] block redefines every token
All dark text/background pairs meet WCAG AA 4.5:1
cards.stopAndReport: A colour in use has no obvious token

cards.title: Theme state hook: saved choice, else OS preference
acceptanceChecks: Defaults to prefers-color-scheme when nothing is saved
A saved choice wins over the OS preference
Storage failure (private mode) falls back without throwing
requiredTests: Jest: default, saved choice, storage failure
cards.stopAndReport: localStorage is unavailable in the test environment

cards.title: Accessible theme toggle and mount it in the app header
acceptanceChecks: A real <button> with aria-pressed reflecting the theme
Operable with Enter and Space; visible focus
Label announces the action (Switch to dark theme)
requiredTests: Jest: click and keyboard toggle update aria-pressed
cards.stopAndReport: main.tsx has changed since the task was written

cards.title: Move existing styles onto the colour tokens
nonGoals: Do not change spacing, layout or typography
acceptanceChecks: No hard-coded colour remains in styles.css
The light theme looks pixel-identical to before
Dark theme renders every state (loading, error, empty, success)
cards.stopAndReport: A rule cannot be expressed with an existing token

cards.title: Automated WCAG AA contrast test for both themes
nonGoals: Do not change colours to make the test pass
acceptanceChecks: Parses tokens.css and checks each text/background pair
Fails when a pair drops below 4.5:1 (negative control)
requiredTests: Jest: all pairs pass in light and dark
cards.stopAndReport: A pair fails AA - report it, do not weaken the threshold

cards.title: Browser flow: toggle, persist across reload, keyboard only
acceptanceChecks: Toggle switches data-theme and the computed page colours
The choice survives a reload
Works using only Tab and Enter
cards.stopAndReport: The toggle is not reachable by keyboard

cards.title: Independent review of the whole diff
acceptanceChecks: Diff stays inside every card's allowed files
Contrast and keyboard checks have evidence
Every finding has a risk level and a required fix
cards.stopAndReport: The diff touches a file no card owns

cards.title: Human merge approval (security and scope verification)
nonGoals: The author may not approve their own change
acceptanceChecks: Final CI passed on the exact final SHA
Reviewer is not the author
cards.stopAndReport: CI is Not Run or blocked by infrastructure
